信函及收据附后，并附译文。

施子良

1937年11月11日下午4时50分，隶属特务科的警司 Pitts 和副督察长 施苏坚（Shih Su Chian）来到本巡捕房，请求协助劝说位于莫利哀路40号光夏中学内的下列组织关闭其办事处：

(1) 全上海武装抗敌后援会分会（上海各界抗敵後援會）。
(2) 上海市学生军训救亡协会。（上海市學生界救亡協會）。
(3) 上海市学生界救亡协会。（上海市學生界救亡協會）。

副督察长 蔡刘、华籍高级探员 121号以及华籍初级探员 83号提供了协助，他们与隶属于特务科的侦探一起，会见了上述组织的秘书杨宗伦先生（楊宗倫），并要求他允许侦探视察所述各组织的各个办事处，该要求获准。经检查，查获了大量与上述组织有关的中文宣传品、文献和文件，并带至本巡捕房，随后移交给特务科的 Pitts 警司进行翻译和列单。

1937年11月11日下午5时，特务科成员在成都路巡捕房代表的陪同下，走访了位于莫利哀路40号的光夏中学（Kwang Hsia），该校址内设有以下政治组织：
(1) 全上海武装抗敌后援会组织委员会。（上海抗敵後援會組織委員會）
(2) 上海市集训学生救亡协会——通讯地址。（上海市集訓學生救亡協會）。

部分校舍目前作为紧急医院运营，而另一大部分则用作数名男女青年学生的宿舍。上述组织使用的办公室共有七间，与用于教学目的的房间明显分开。
庄仲芳先生（Zung Chung Foo）和杨仲陵先生（Yang Chung Ling）均在警察走访时在场，两人均为当地党部成员，也是全上海武装抗敌后援会的秘书及负责人；需指出的是，该会是上海所有救亡团体的母体机构。警方告知了他们走访的原因，并最终说服他们停止自今年七月成立以来该会所进行的此类活动。

TRANSLATION

General Principles of Propaganda by
the Propaganda Department of the All Shanghai Association for
the Support of Armed Resistance

A) Positive methods

1) To increase the racial consciousness of the people.
2) To foster patriotic feeling amongst the people.
3) To encourage the resisting spirit of the people.
4) To cultivate the racial confidence of the people.
5) To convince the people of the necessity for fighting
towards their emancipation.
6) To convince the people of the truth that a strong nation
requires strong people.
7) To convince the people of the truth that one must sacrifice
one's freedom for the sake of the freedom of the nation.
8) To convince the people that their survival means the
survival of the nation and that their destruction means
the destruction of the nation.
9) To advise the people to economize in food, clothing and
strength in order to support the government.
10) To advise the people to offer their property and strength
to the nation.
11) To advise the people to offer their knowledge and skill
to the nation.
12) To advise the people not to be proud when a minor victory has
been obtained or to be dispirited when an insignificant
defeat has been sustained, but to persist in their
struggle until a final victory has been attained.
13) To advise the people to cope with the situation by assuming
a calm attitude.
14) To advise the people not to flinch from danger or to
surrender at a critical hour.
15) To advise the people to observe order, to obey the
government's instructions, to support the leaders and
to carry out their duties under the supervision

宣传总纲

A) 积极方法

1) 提高民众的民族意识。
2) 培养民众的爱国情感。
3) 鼓励民众的抵抗精神。
4) 培育民众的民族自信心。
5) 使民众确信为争取解放而战斗的必要性。
6) 使民众确信强国需有强民这一真理。
7) 使民众确信为了国家的自由必须牺牲个人自由这一真理。
8) 使民众相信他们的生存意味着国家的生存，他们的毁灭意味着国家的毁灭。
9) 劝告民众在衣食和体力上节约，以支持政府。
10) 劝告民众将财产和体力贡献给国家。
11) 劝告民众将知识和技能贡献给国家。
12) 劝告民众在取得小胜时不骄傲，在遭受小败时不气馁，而是坚持斗争直到取得最终胜利。
13) 劝告民众以冷静的态度应对局势。
14) 劝告民众在危急时刻不畏危险，不投降。
15) 劝告民众遵守秩序，服从政府指令，拥护领袖，并在政府的监督下履行职责

16) To advise the people how to acquire war time knowledge.
17) To advise the people to keep a watch on traitors and to

18) To advise the people to render relief to refugees and to

B) Negative methods
1) To prevent individualism, pacificism and all class
struggles.
2) To guard against mere talk, superstitious beliefs, and
the false hope that assistance will be coming from
others.
3) To prevent all schemes that will cause dissension among
the people and rupture the unity of the people.
4) To prevent all ideas that are reactionary, advocate
hedonism and asceticism.
5) To prevent individual movements that are contrary to the
policy of the government in order to avoid any incident
that will compromise the government's policy.
6) To prevent all ideas of showing indifference to the
national affairs and seeking the protection of foreigners.

Remarks
1) Newspaper circles are to be requested to publish articles
in elucidation of the above programme.
2) Art and literary circles are to be requested to write articles
on the basis of the above programme.
3) Dramatic circles are to be requested to stage plays or to make
films emphasizing the above programme.
4) Choral and musical circles are to be requested to make songs
embodying the above programme.
5) Educational circles are to be requested to write text books
embodying the above programme.

B) 消极方法
1) 防止个人主义、和平主义及一切阶级斗争。
2) 警惕空谈、迷信信念以及指望他人援助的错误希望。
3) 防止一切导致民众分歧和破坏民众团结的阴谋。
4) 防止一切反动思想，以及提倡享乐主义和苦行主义的思想。
5) 防止违背政府政策的个人行动，以避免发生任何损害政府政策的事件。
6) 防止一切对国事漠不关心并寻求外国人保护的思想。

being waged in the front. In conclusion, the speaker expressed
the desire that all should do their utmost in the task, but

the Planning Committee.

October 30, 1937.

All Shanghai Association for the Support of Armed
Resistance - Meeting

A meeting which was attended by about thirty persons
representing various national salvation associations took
place at 4.30 p.m. October 29 at 470 Hankow Road under the
auspices of the All Shanghai Association for the Support of
Armed Resistance. The following resolutions were discussed
and passed :-

1. That a manifesto be issued setting forth the view
points of the association regarding the forthcoming
Nine Power Conference.

2. That a circular telegram be despatched to the people
throughout the country requesting them to voice their
opinion regarding the conference.

3. That several representatives be appointed to request
the support of the local consular authorities.

4. That telegrams be despatched to the forthcoming Nine
Power Conference requesting the participants to uphold
justice and the Chinese delegate at Brussels requesting
him to remain firm on China's stand.

5. That a telegram be despatched to the Chamber of
Commerce, financial circles, labour organizations,
cultural and educational bodies of foreign countries
requesting them to assist in the application of
sanctions against Japan.

6. That telegrams be despatched to Chinese students
in Europe requesting them to submit appeals to the
Nine Power Conference.

7. That the various national salvation associations be
notified not to reveal any information relating to
their activities in order to avoid interference by
the Police.

军队集结

为组织上海华人应对中日之间可能爆发战争后的局势，并支持抵抗日本侵略的中国士兵，“上海各界抗敌后援会”于今日上午9时在苏州北路（North Soochow Road）上海市商会大楼举行的会议上正式成立。

债券价格回升
鉴于华北方面传来中日军队正在撤退、重大冲突危险显著降低的报告，今晨上海华商证券交易所的中国政府债券价格回升，统一公债较昨日下午收盘价从2.05美元涨至3.50美元。

根据交易所规定，单日交易的最大涨跌幅为1美元。因此，今晨的上涨幅度为50美分，未超过最大限额。

此次会议由包括市商会、上海市民协会、总工会、银行公会、律师公会以及第一、第二特区市民协会在内的各重要机构高级官员组成的联合委员会召集，四百余名各公共团体代表出席了今日的成立大会。

阐释政策

会议期间发表了演讲，赞扬南京政府针对华北危机的政策，并谴责日本的侵略行径。会上还讨论了其他常规措施。

在上海的外籍华人社区成员也积极行动。国民党领袖廖仲恺夫人向孙逸仙夫人、宋子文夫人、孔祥熙夫人、张学良夫人、陈友仁夫人及其他中国高官的眷属发出邀请，请她们出席将于周日下午在大光明大戏院（Grand Theatre）举行的大型群众集会。

大上海市政府社会局已采取有效措施，遏制近几日记录在案的商品价格上涨，尤其是米价和蔬菜价格。各同业公会已奉命设定最高限价。

中国当局还非正式地透露，无需对上海的防务感到焦虑。已与周边城市做出安排，以便在紧急情况下对该地区进行联合防御。虽然根据1932年的停战协定，上海附近20公里范围内为非军事区，但据悉中国军队已在上海周围大量集结，必要时将保卫该城市。除这些部队外，上海还拥有一支精锐的保安团和大上海市政府辖下的强大警力。
